speaker: Ms Foo Mee Har
text: asked the Minister for National Development whether the Government will consider implementing a tiered pricing schedule, aligned with tiered Stay-Home Notice Dedicated Facilities so as to offer inbound travellers a choice of accommodation that is commensurate with their affordability and level of comfort.

speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: Protecting the community from imported cases is our key priority, and multiple agencies and hotel partners work closely together to implement health, security, transport and accommodation arrangements to do so.

speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: Travellers are “bubble wrapped” from the moment that they arrive at the checkpoints, all the way to the SDFs, with strict infection prevention and control measures maintained throughout the process.

speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: To minimise operational complexity, travellers are assigned to SDFs when they arrive at the checkpoints.

speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: At the same time, we recognise that certain travellers may have specific needs.

speaker: Ms Foo Mee Har (West Coast)
text: I understand that, operationally, it can be quite complicated to allow the travellers to choose.

speaker: Ms Foo Mee Har (West Coast)
text: But I would like to appeal to the Government, given that we have been in this phase for almost a year now and that many families especially those who need to go through the quarantine period, for example, those bringing in foreign domestic helpers, I have had many residents come and appeal, that the cost is really quite significant for the families to bear.

speaker: Ms Foo Mee Har (West Coast)
text: So, I would like to appeal for the Government to really think of a more economical option so that families who do need to go through a quarantine for different reasons, including onboarding of foreign domestic helpers for the care-giving needs, can have a more economical option for them to choose.

speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
text: As the Member pointed out, it is indeed operationally complex to have the entire system with strict Infection, Prevention and Control measures (IPCs), from the moment the travellers arrive at the checkpoint, how to identify the Persons on Stay-Home Notice (PSHN), to assign them to the SDF, to assign them the transport arrangements to the SDF, managing the PSHNs in the SDF itself, and finally, the in situ exit processes before we release the PSHN.

speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
text: These are complex operations and issues, with many moving parts.

speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
text: That is why we take a lot care to make sure the robust measures are in place.
